archimate:WorkPackage.name: Month 2 - Evaluation & Strategy Iteration
archimate:WorkPackage.documentation: Rationalization: Review current platforms for reuse, retirement, or integration Market Scan: Identify off the shelf options and shortlist functional/technical fits Risk Mitigation: Highlight "no regrets" sustainment tasks to secure the current estate. Sourcing Strategy: Decide which components to own/build vs outsource
